column9: Large scale analysis of peptide-HLA class I interactions
column102: In general, this data has been generated using a quantitative biochemical peptide-HLA interaction assay (see PMID: 12135423). The HLA class I molecules have been selected to cover the known HLA supertypes (using PMID: 14963618).
